stops.name: Setesdal-Bahn
stops.detail: The route of the Setesdal Railway, which has since been largely closed or regauged, ran through the Setesdal along the river Otra.

stops.name: Grovane
stops.detail: Today, a museum railway runs on the eight-kilometer section between the stations of Grovane and Røyknes.
